title: `teploy backup restore --json`: the quiesced restore receipt (backup-json-v1, rev 14).

stopped.description: Containers stopped for the restore (the app's processes, plus a generic accessory's container for accessory restores).

health.description: Post-restore health check of the app's web process; skipped when nothing was stopped (undeployed app).

recovery_dir.description: Present when the pre-restore data copy was KEPT (health failed after promotion, or a recovery-incomplete failure): the operator's way back.
